title: Legacy Manhunts Reworked
description: An easy to use manhunt plugin made for 1.12.2, or Eaglercraft, that just works
body:
Adds manhunts in version 1.12.2, and bypasses the use of a compass, which is an issue in all other 1.12.2 manhunt plugins.

Hunters' action bars are used to show an arrow, pointing towards the runner.

![Arrow to hunter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/840bb799f93fbf9138f0ffd1a1cbe2e35c104b77.png)

The arrow points towards any portal the runner uses to leave the dimension

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b21c3947a0c60f6bac7be417ce0df2b1765dcc2.png)
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5a945e19eba3126e24eb5425c0bb6bb3cbe4e15b.png)
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd3189578806421c98ea851e5c00d1043afdc901.png)

Only supports up to 1 hunter and 1 speedrunner

**Adds a 40% drop rate of Ender Pearls from Wither Skeletons**, because otherwise the manhunt is slow and unreasonable for a runner to complete

**Commands:** 

- /hunter set <playername>
  - Sets the hunter
- /speedrunner set <playername>
  - Sets the speedrunner
- /resetmanhunt
  - Clears roles and portal location data
